name: One media plan drives every renderer
asks: one shared upstream contract and code that both Google Flow video production and the deterministically generated microdrama/micro-serial videos consume

met-when.says: A JSON-Schema'd MediaPlan (script, scenes, shots, assets, captions, audio, render target, publication metadata, source provenance, links to paper) exists in computer-media-engineering-services-section and is the only input shape the Flow order compiler and the deterministic render compiler accept.
Compilation is a Hoare-contracted pure function: coded refusals before any output, a deterministic receipt after, effects none; a receiving party can verify the receipt by recompiling.
google-flow prepares priced, unsubmitted orders from a plan; queueing is explicit and spending remains flow-generate's.
The procedural renderer renders a plan end to end locally and checks frame count, geometry, duration and captions against the compile receipt.
The education short producer, the Public Fiction commission pipeline and the Climate Place-By-Place video thread emit media plans instead of hand-built order lines and episode JSON.

x-provenance.source: Owner request: one shared upstream media contract for Google Flow and the deterministic microdrama renderer; standing rule no-work-outside-an-office-duty-and-skill
